0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, 12th in the East) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-9, 14th in the West) on a four-game losing streak, with Orlando 0-4 at home and 2-3 on the road, while Sacramento is on a three-game skid and 0-5 at home. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero, and Desmond Bane is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons, Domantas Sabonis and Maxime Raynaud. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Magic won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 121-117 win in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
